resources.string: Sends one task to an external A2A agent: admission first (a peer that never passed the exam is not given work), then the outbound lease gate, then the task is sent and polled until it settles. Returns a terminal state or input-required - to supply what is missing, call again with the original task id so the same task continues instead of starting over. writes=true means the peer has to touch its own disk or an external resource; only a peer admitted at FULL tier takes those. Every single delegation needs the user to approve a confirmation card before a byte leaves the device. Hidden by default: unlock the multi-agent group in capabilities first.

Runs the admission exam against one external A2A agent on its own, without delegating work first: nine questions (five probes plus four conduct checks) are really sent to the peer, and its admission profile and tier are updated in place. Pass = usable (reads and writes); arithmetic slips or poor discipline = demoted to read-only (write tasks are refused, read tasks still go - demotion is not disabling); knowingly crossing a red line = not used. Retakes go through here too: the old paper does not count and the exam really runs again. The exam itself is outbound traffic, so every run needs the user to approve a confirmation card before a question byte leaves the device. Two separate rulers: whether it can write is in the exam ledger, which tier it was filed under is in the admission ledger. Hidden by default: unlock the multi-agent group in capabilities first.
